verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an open-source Python library for running the agent locally ([browser-use-docs-19], [browser-use-gh-3]), and a community user confirms running it locally against their own browser profile ([browser-use-comm-5]). However, the docs describe this library as separate from the Cloud Agent and Browser APIs ([browser-use-probe-1]). The cloud's hardened stealth Chromium, residential proxies, automatic CAPTCHA solving and saved profiles are documented only as managed cloud features ([browser-use-docs-6], [browser-use-docs-7], [browser-use-docs-8], [browser-use-docs-24]). missing for 10: a self-hostable version of the Cloud Agent/Browser API, self-hosted equivalents of the stealth/proxy/CAPTCHA/profile infrastructure, and explicit license or deployment documentation for self-hosting.
